work_summary: Added PR C pseudonym-gate observability endpoint (PR #158). New GET /api/v1/health/pseudonym-gate (admin-only) reports line_id_plaintext_fallback_hit counter (in-memory + Redis-shared) so operators can verify the PR C gate (zero hits 3-5 days in dual mode) without Koyeb log access. Files: app/core/pseudonym_gate.py (counter), app/services/user_identity_service.py (hook on plaintext fallback), app/api/v1/endpoints/health.py (endpoint), tests/test_pseudonym_gate.py (11 tests). Backend suite 753 passed, CI all green. Branch feat/pseudonym-gate-endpoint pushed, PR #158 open awaiting review/merge.
